CREATE TABLE admin_users (
	email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (email)
)


CREATE TABLE branches (
	name_az TEXT NOT NULL, 
	name_en TEXT NOT NULL, 
	city TEXT NOT NULL, 
	address TEXT NOT NULL, 
	country_code VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL, 
	opening_hours JSONB NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE extras (
	code VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	name_az TEXT NOT NULL, 
	name_en TEXT NOT NULL, 
	description_az TEXT NOT NULL, 
	description_en TEXT NOT NULL, 
	price_qepik BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	billing_unit VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	stock_total INTEGER, 
	eligibility_rules JSONB NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (price_qepik >= 0), 
	CHECK (stock_total IS NULL OR stock_total >= 0), 
	UNIQUE (code)
)


CREATE TABLE fx_rates (
	currency_code VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, 
	effective_date DATE NOT NULL, 
	azn_per_unit NUMERIC(18, 8) NOT NULL, 
	source_url TEXT NOT NULL, 
	fetched_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (currency_code, effective_date), 
	CHECK (azn_per_unit > 0)
)


CREATE TABLE audit_events (
	actor_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	actor_id UUID, 
	action VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	entity_type VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	entity_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	request_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	before_snapshot JSONB, 
	after_snapshot JSONB, 
	reason TEXT, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE sessions (
	token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	actor_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	admin_user_id UUID, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	revoked_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (token_hash), 
	FOREIGN KEY(admin_user_id) REFERENCES admin_users (id)
)


CREATE TABLE rental_policies (
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	rules JSONB NOT NULL, 
	policy_bundle_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	published_by UUID, 
	published_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(published_by) REFERENCES admin_users (id)
)


CREATE TABLE policy_documents (
	document_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	topic TEXT NOT NULL, 
	language VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	branch_id UUID, 
	source_asset_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	full_text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	content_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	effective_from TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	effective_until TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	reviewed_by UUID, 
	reviewed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (document_key, language, version), 
	FOREIGN KEY(branch_id) REFERENCES branches (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reviewed_by) REFERENCES admin_users (id)
)


CREATE TABLE idempotency_records (
	session_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	key VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	operation VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	result_reference JSONB NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (session_id, key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES sessions (id)
)


CREATE TABLE conversations (
	session_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	language VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	contact_name TEXT, 
	contact_email TEXT, 
	contact_phone TEXT, 
	session_state JSONB NOT NULL, 
	state_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	active_draft_id UUID, 
	last_activity_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	retention_due_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES sessions (id)
)

CREATE INDEX ix_conversations_session_id ON conversations (session_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_conversations_retention_due_at ON conversations (retention_due_at)

CREATE TABLE rate_plans (
	code TEXT NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	daily_rate_qepik BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	deposit_qepik BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	tax_basis_points INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	tax_mode VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	rental_policy_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_by UUID, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (code, version), 
	CHECK (daily_rate_qepik >= 0 AND deposit_qepik >= 0), 
	CHECK (tax_basis_points BETWEEN 0 AND 10000), 
	FOREIGN KEY(rental_policy_id) REFERENCES rental_policies (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES admin_users (id)
)


CREATE TABLE policy_chunks (
	document_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	chunk_index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	section_reference TEXT NOT NULL, 
	search_vector TSVECTOR NOT NULL, 
	embedding VECTOR(1536) NOT NULL, 
	embedding_model TEXT NOT NULL, 
	content_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(document_id) REFERENCES policy_documents (id)
)

CREATE INDEX policy_embedding ON policy_chunks USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops)
CREATE INDEX policy_search ON policy_chunks USING gin (search_vector)

CREATE TABLE chat_logs (
	conversation_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	sequence BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	client_event_id UUID, 
	role VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	raw_content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	payload JSONB NOT NULL, 
	agent_run_id UUID, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (conversation_id, sequence), 
	UNIQUE (conversation_id, client_event_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id)
)

CREATE INDEX ix_chat_logs_conversation_id ON chat_logs (conversation_id)

CREATE TABLE vehicles (
	registration_number TEXT NOT NULL, 
	make TEXT NOT NULL, 
	model TEXT NOT NULL, 
	model_year INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	vehicle_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	class_code VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	seats INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	fuel_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	transmission VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	branch_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	rate_plan_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	features JSONB NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (seats > 0), 
	UNIQUE (registration_number), 
	FOREIGN KEY(branch_id) REFERENCES branches (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(rate_plan_id) REFERENCES rate_plans (id)
)


CREATE TABLE pricing_rules (
	rate_plan_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	amount_qepik BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	effective_dates DATERANGE, 
	conditions JSONB NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(rate_plan_id) REFERENCES rate_plans (id)
)


CREATE TABLE quotes (
	conversation_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	action_kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	reservation_id UUID, 
	inputs_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL, 
	policy_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL, 
	rate_plan_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	fx_rate_id UUID, 
	total_qepik BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	deposit_qepik BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	delta_qepik BIGINT, 
	signature VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	valid_until TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	operation_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (total_qepik >= 0 AND deposit_qepik >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(rate_plan_id) REFERENCES rate_plans (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(fx_rate_id) REFERENCES fx_rates (id), 
	UNIQUE (operation_key)
)


CREATE TABLE conversion_events (
	conversation_id UUID, 
	event_name VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, 
	attributes JSONB NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id)
)


CREATE TABLE agent_runs (
	conversation_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	client_event_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	input_log_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	event_kind VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	checkpoint_id TEXT, 
	response_log_id UUID, 
	input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	output_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	error_code VARCHAR(80), 
	started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	finished_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (conversation_id, client_event_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(input_log_id) REFERENCES chat_logs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(response_log_id) REFERENCES chat_logs (id)
)


CREATE TABLE vehicle_photos (
	vehicle_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	asset_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	alt_az TEXT NOT NULL, 
	alt_en TEXT NOT NULL, 
	sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(vehicle_id) REFERENCES vehicles (id)
)


CREATE TABLE quote_items (
	quote_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	code VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, 
	label_az TEXT NOT NULL, 
	label_en TEXT NOT NULL, 
	quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	unit_amount_qepik BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	line_total_qepik BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	rule_reference JSONB NOT NULL, 
	sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(quote_id) REFERENCES quotes (id)
)


CREATE TABLE reservations (
	public_reference VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id UUID, 
	vehicle_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	pickup_branch_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	return_branch_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	pickup_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	return_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	current_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	total_qepik BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	deposit_qepik BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	renter_contact JSONB NOT NULL, 
	payment_method VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (return_at > pickup_at), 
	CHECK (total_qepik >= 0 AND deposit_qepik >= 0), 
	UNIQUE (public_reference), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(vehicle_id) REFERENCES vehicles (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(pickup_branch_id) REFERENCES branches (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(return_branch_id) REFERENCES branches (id)
)


CREATE TABLE booking_drafts (
	conversation_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	quote_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	action_kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	reservation_id UUID, 
	base_reservation_version INTEGER, 
	proposal JSONB NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	committed_version_id UUID, 
	operation_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(quote_id) REFERENCES quotes (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations (id), 
	UNIQUE (operation_key)
)


CREATE TABLE reservation_versions (
	reservation_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	action_kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	quote_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	snapshot JSONB NOT NULL, 
	actor_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	actor_id UUID, 
	reason TEXT, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (reservation_id, version), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(quote_id) REFERENCES quotes (id)
)


CREATE TABLE booking_access_grants (
	session_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	reservation_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	permissions JSONB NOT NULL, 
	revoked_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (session_id, reservation_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES sessions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations (id)
)


CREATE TABLE escalation_cases (
	conversation_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	reservation_id UUID, 
	reason_code VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, 
	summary TEXT NOT NULL, 
	source_log_ids JSONB NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	assigned_admin_id UUID, 
	resolution JSONB, 
	opened_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	resolved_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(assigned_admin_id) REFERENCES admin_users (id)
)


CREATE TABLE vehicle_allocations (
	vehicle_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	period TSTZRANGE NOT NULL, 
	purpose VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	draft_id UUID, 
	reservation_id UUID, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT no_vehicle_overlap EXCLUDE USING gist (vehicle_id WITH =, period WITH &&) WHERE (status = 'ACTIVE'), 
	CHECK (NOT isempty(period)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(vehicle_id) REFERENCES vehicles (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(draft_id) REFERENCES booking_drafts (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations (id)
)


CREATE TABLE extra_allocations (
	extra_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	period TSTZRANGE NOT NULL, 
	quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	draft_id UUID, 
	reservation_id UUID, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (quantity > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(extra_id) REFERENCES extras (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(draft_id) REFERENCES booking_drafts (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations (id)
)

CREATE INDEX extra_window ON extra_allocations USING gist (extra_id, period)

CREATE TABLE approved_adjustments (
	escalation_case_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	reservation_id UUID, 
	amount_qepik BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	approved_by UUID NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	consumed_by_version_id UUID, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(escalation_case_id) REFERENCES escalation_cases (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(approved_by) REFERENCES admin_users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(consumed_by_version_id) REFERENCES reservation_versions (id)
)

ALTER TABLE booking_drafts ADD CONSTRAINT fk_draft_committed_version FOREIGN KEY(committed_version_id) REFERENCES reservation_versions (id)
ALTER TABLE quotes ADD CONSTRAINT fk_quote_reservation FOREIGN KEY(reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations (id)
ALTER TABLE chat_logs ADD CONSTRAINT fk_chat_run FOREIGN KEY(agent_run_id) REFERENCES agent_runs (id)
ALTER TABLE conversations ADD CONSTRAINT fk_conversation_draft FOREIGN KEY(active_draft_id) REFERENCES booking_drafts (id)
